visible.title: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'cv2' while deploying streamlit app
visible.body:
### Checklist

### Summary

Just doing random app using cv2 and streamlit when i tried to deploy following error occurs.kindly help me to solve this error!!1

### Reproducible Code Example

```Python
import streamlit as st
from PIL import Image
import cv2
import numpy as np

select=st.selectbox("pick",["camera","upload image"])
if select=="camera":
    cam=st.camera_input("capture a photo")
    if cam is not None:
        file_bytes = np.asarray(bytearray(cam.read()), dtype=np.uint8)
        opencv_image = cv2.imdecode(file_bytes, 1)
        st.image(opencv_image,channel="RGB")

else:
    uploaded_file = st.file_uploader("Choose a image file", type=["jpg","png"])
    if uploaded_file is not None:
        file_bytes = np.asarray(bytearray(uploaded_file.read()), dtype=np.uint8)
        opencv_image1= cv2.imdecode(file_bytes, 1)
        st.image(opencv_image1,channels="BGR")
```
